body:
## Summary

The `--hud` vanilla-HUD route has landed for the other four legacy-track games (M48.4 Oblivion MenuXml → M48.5 FO3 MenuXml → M48.6 Skyrim Scaleform/AVM1 → M48.7 FO4 Scaleform/AVM2; see the ROADMAP M48 row and `byroredux/src/scaleform_hud.rs`'s `ScaleformGame` dispatch). Starfield is the remaining leg — and it is **blocked on scenes loading properly**, plus one newly-found parser blocker below.

Corpus facts (installed AE-era install, verified read-only): the HUD lives in `Starfield - Interface.ba2` as `interface\hudmenu.swf` (plus `hudmenu_lrg.swf`/`.gfx` large-UI variants and the separate `spaceshiphudmenu(_lrg).swf` ship HUD), and the archive opens fine through the existing BA2 v8 reader (`--menu-archive` accepts it).

## Blocker 1 — scenes must load properly (the named prerequisite)

The M48.6/M48.7 smoke pattern gates a HUD over a **live, stable cell**: boot the fixture cell, pin `hud.values`, screenshot, `hud.off`, screenshot again, and pixel-diff — which requires the scene to render and stay static between captures. Today's Starfield state (ROADMAP + `docs/engine/game-compatibility.md`):

- **Walkable Cydonia interior exists** (Session 42 bring-up #1289–#1295: CDB `.mat` wiring, XCLL canonical-size split, `BSGeometry` external `.mesh` resolution, trimesh-fallback gate, door-teleporter spawn; `--esm Starfield.esm --cell citycydoniamainlevel`, `sf_smoke` baseline tool, `[profiles.starfield]`).
- ESM parse is broad (~99.9% of `Starfield.esm`; 11 985 interior / 18 424 exterior cells, ~3.29 M REFRs) — but breadth is not the gate; a **renderable, stable, smoke-able cell** is.
- Known scene-side gaps that would show on screen or break the diff gate: object/distant LOD not exercised (`cell_loader/object_lod.rs` — no Starfield arm; `.bto`-keyed scheme vs Starfield's `lod\generated\_lod_N.nif`), actors lack walk animation (M42.x), ragdolls blocked on the `BhkSystemBinary` blob decoder, and material fidelity gaps (#3398 CDB Phase 2, #4429 missing roughness/metalness/AO/opacity texture roles ≈ 39 % of Starfield textures).

**Done means:** a chosen interior cell renders and holds still across two `screenshot` captures under `--bench-hold` (the m48-6 §Gate-4 precondition), with the fixture captured in `docs/smoke-tests/fixtures/` (env `BYROREDUX_STARFIELD_DATA` following the #3435 dual-env lesson).

## Blocker 2 — Ruffle cannot parse Starfield's SWF dialect (found 2026-09-19, probed on `hudmenu.swf`)

```
--menu interface\hudmenu.swf --menu-archive "Starfield - Interface.ba2"
→ Failed to load archive menu 'interface\hudmenu.swf' from 'Starfield - Interface.ba2':
  parsing SWF: Error parsing SWF tag DefineSprite: Error parsing SWF tag
  PlaceObject3: Invalid data: Invalid PlaceObject type
```

The pinned Ruffle rev (`0dde9813`) rejects a PlaceObject3 form Starfield's Scaleform authoring emits. Needs a dialect investigation: decode the offending record from the shipped SWF, decide patched-tag-reader vs upstream fix, and re-pin. Until this lands, no Starfield menu can even enter the profile detector (the AS1/AS3 classification of Starfield menus is therefore also unconfirmed — expected AS3/AVM2 like FO4, but the parse dies first).

## Remaining work once unblocked

- `ScaleformGame::Starfield` arm in `scaleform_hud.rs` (archive probe `Starfield - Interface.ba2`; `hud.rs`'s MenuXml skip-guard already lists Scaleform-era archives — add this one).
- A `ScaleformProfile::Starfield` variant + its own host catalog (today's detector would route any AS3 Starfield movie to `Fallout4Avm2`, whose 269-method `BGSCodeObj` catalog and injected adapter are FO4-specific; Starfield's host protocol needs its own corpus sweep à la #3103).
- Driver bars/labels decided at bring-up (health/O2 expected), transparent stage + `set_input_focus(false)` (shared, already game-agnostic).
- `crates/ui/tests/starfield_hudmenu_protocol.rs` mirroring the Skyrim/FO4 pins.
- Smoke `m48-8-starfield-hud.sh` + README row; ROADMAP M48.8 paragraph.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A Starfield fixture cell renders stable across captures (Blocker 1 exit)
- [ ] `--menu interface\hudmenu.swf --menu-archive "Starfield - Interface.ba2"` loads with a Starfield profile (Blocker 2 exit)
- [ ] `--hud` on that install boots: `hud: loaded … backend=scaleform profile=<Starfield> state=…`
- [ ] `hud.status` / `hud.values` / `hud.debug` / `hud.off` behave as on Skyrim/FO4
- [ ] `m48-8-starfield-hud.sh` PASS (boot + status + debug + chrome on/off diff), and m48-4/5/6/7 + m48-menu-load stay green

Non-goals: the ship HUD (`spaceshiphudmenu.swf`), `_lrg` variants, menu stack, font fidelity.
